qa_pairs.question: How can a user view the available command-line options for `cfx5solve` and what are some important options for running Ansys CFX simulations?
qa_pairs.answer: To view available command-line options for `cfx5solve`, users should first load the appropriate Ansys module and then run `cfx5solve -help`. Important options include `-single` for single-precision calculations (the default), `-double` for double-precision calculations (which doubles memory requirements), and `-large` for handling larger meshes up to 2 billion elements (compared to the default support for 80 million structured or 200 million unstructured elements).

qa_pairs.question: When submitting CFX jobs to Alliance clusters, how are the Slurm scripts configured for parallel execution across single and multiple compute nodes, and which MPI implementations are typically used?
qa_pairs.answer: For single-node CFX jobs, Slurm scripts specify `cfx5solve -start-method "Open MPI Local Parallel"` on Narval or Fir clusters, and `"Intel MPI Local Parallel"` on other clusters. For multi-node jobs, they use `"Open MPI Distributed Parallel"` on Narval or Fir, and `"Intel MPI Distributed Parallel"` on other clusters. For Intel MPI, the `I_MPI_HYDRA_BOOTSTRAP=ssh` environment variable is exported.
